cohort.population: new tasks with a current canonical binding admitted during the fixed canary interval
cohort.selection: unsigned first 32 bits of sha256(task_id || ':' || target_sha) modulo 10000 is below rolloutBasisPoints
cohort.denominator: every eligible new task selected into the immutable target-SHA cohort; a missing observation is a V2 failure when the window closes
exclusions: task had no current canonical binding at admission
task was explicitly opted out before admission
target SHA changed before the first observation

falseClose.numerator: selected tasks reported closed while the canonical evaluation still has a blocking dimension or mandatory obligation
falseClose.denominator: selected tasks with a canonical evaluation in the observation window

missedObligation.numerator: canonical mandatory obligations absent from the versioned read model
missedObligation.denominator: canonical mandatory obligations expected for selected tasks in the observation window

readModelDifference.numerator: selected task read models whose digest differs from the canonical expected digest
readModelDifference.denominator: selected task read models compared with the same canonical cut

reconciliationLag.numerator: p99 wall-clock milliseconds between canonical fact ingestion and versioned projection evaluation
reconciliationLag.denominator: selected task projections with both ingestion and evaluation timestamps

oldestObligation.numerator: maximum age in seconds of an active mandatory obligation
oldestObligation.denominator: active mandatory obligations observed for selected tasks

expiredLease.numerator: expired coordinator leases for selected task obligations
expiredLease.denominator: claimed coordinator leases examined in the observation window

retryCost.numerator: bounded retry cost units consumed by selected task attempts
retryCost.denominator: selected task attempts observed in the window

inboxAge.numerator: p99 age in seconds of pending decision or watchdog inbox entries
inboxAge.denominator: pending inbox entries for selected tasks

outboxFailure.numerator: terminal or retry-exhausted projection/coordinator outbox deliveries
outboxFailure.denominator: projection/coordinator outbox delivery attempts for selected tasks

checksumDrift.numerator: selected projection subjects whose rowset/proof/gate/read-surface checksum differs from a source replay
checksumDrift.denominator: selected projection subjects independently checksummed in the window

acceptanceRuntimeDeadline.numerator: admitted executable acceptances clamped, stopped at the legacy cutoff, or completed after their negotiated deadline
acceptanceRuntimeDeadline.denominator: admitted executable acceptance traces with a version-bound requested and effective deadline

security.tenantAuthorization: authenticated tenant digest must equal the stored tenant digest
